description: Top 40 arterial road intersections for heavy vehicles is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. This ranking lists the 40 busiest at grade arterial road intersections in terms of heavy vehicle exposure. This dataset is restricted to the prescribed years below and will not be updated. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are heavy vehicles, intersection, road traffic, roads. It offers 3 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
